_readme: Single source of truth for the narration. `text` is what is said and captioned, exactly as
it should read on screen. `tts` is what the voice is fed: identical words, but loanwords
espeak mispronounces are given as raw IPA in [[ ]] (punctuation inside the block, or the
pause is lost). `words` lists the displayed word for each spoken word group, in order —
tools/vo.py refuses to write timings if the voice produced a different number of words.
